about: One price table of the workbench, in dollars per million tokens, read by the runtime (a run's cost, the auto ranking, the proof page) and by the API adapter. An entry is keyed by the id its provider endpoint uses, plus the other ids the workbench writes for the same model (aliases). `source` is where the price was read and `accessed` the day. A kind an entry leaves out is unknown. Entries from OpenRouter are written by scripts/update_prices.py; re-check every other source before changing a price, and update accessed. A price older than the project's price_max_age_days (default 90) is shown as stale.

openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: priced at the pinned provider deepinfra, not at the cheapest endpoint of the model; OpenRouter lists a discount of 30% on this endpoint; the entry holds the listed price
